node.statement: Corner and norm facts: for X in S_{P,Q}, the compression-adjoint identity in def-compressed-corner gives X^dagger in S_{Q,P}; the involution axiom in def-epsilon-cstar-algebra gives ||X^dagger||=||X||; and the compressed-product definition places X^dagger dot Y in S_{Q,Q}=S_Q for Y in S_{P,Q}.
